name: Ledanca (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over red with a white triangle with its base along the hoist bearing three blue wavy stripes.
history: The arms of Ledanca were approved on 6 February 2006 and the flag on the same day, published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 24 February 2006; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, divided horizontally into halves, green above and red below, with a white triangle at the hoist charged with blue waves.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
three wavy stripes on the triangle
